# The Farm Stories

> The Farm Stories is a farm-community developer based in Coimbatore, Tamil Nadu, India. It finds and verifies agricultural land in South India and develops small, low-density orchard communities of privately owned farm plots with shared amenities, planned around the trees already on the land. Its first project is Mango Meadows in Agali, Attappadi (Palakkad district, Kerala), developed with GK Properties.

Key facts (confirmed by the founders, November 2026):

- Project: Mango Meadows by The Farm Stories ("Story One").
- Location: Agali, Attappadi, Palakkad district, Kerala, in the foothills near the Nilgiris. About 90 minutes by road from Coimbatore. 1.5 km from Narasimukku viewpoint.
- Size: 7.4 acres, 22 private plots of 18.7 to 29.6 cents each, 280+ mature mango trees retained on site.
- Shared amenities: signature entrance arch, perimeter fencing, internal roads, street lighting, a swale with hammocks, a pavilion and a tree house, and "the House": a clubhouse with a swimming pool, poolside bar, table tennis, pool table, three guest rooms, an open terrace and a 360° view deck.
- Homes: owners may build their own home in the community's shared architectural language, or choose "The Nest", a pre-designed 1,000 sq ft home with two bedrooms and one bathroom. Optional build packages are available.
- Farm programme: "Maanga Petti", a farm-food initiative with mango picking, pickle and preserve workshops, and a seasonal one-mango meal.
- Documentation: clear title, patta, encumbrance certificate (EC) and survey sketch; plots are ready to register.
- Not to be confused with: Mango Meadows Agri Theme Park (Kottayam, Kerala) or the Mango Meadows plotted layout in Ranga Reddy district, Telangana. Those are unrelated.
